newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bomb kills three Israeli soldiers in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Bomb kills three Israeli soldiers in Lebanon.

text.p: Three Israeli soldiers were killed and one seriously wounded when Hizbollah guerrillas detonated a roadside bomb in their patrol in south Lebanon early on Thursday, pro-Israeli militia sources said.

The attack, which took place shortly after midnight, targeted the foot patrol in the Shoumariyyeh area in the central sector of Israel' south Lebanon occupation zone, the South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia sources said.
In Israel, an army spokeswoman confirmed the report, saying three Israeli soldiers were killed and one was moderately wounded in an explosion in south Lebanon.
In a statement in Beirut, the pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) claimed responsibility for the bomb assault.

"At exactly midnight, a foot patrol of the enemy's army was moving on the Deir Siryan-Alman road. The Islamic Resistance strugglers kept the force patrol under surveillance for a while and waited for it to reach a certain point...Then they set off a bomb that caused a big number of casualties," the group said.
The Israeli deaths were the first this year since January 8 when one soldier was killed in a clash in which three guerrillas of the pro-Syrian Amal Movement also died.
So far this year four Israeli soldiers have been killed and 12 wounded in south Lebanon. Last year, 27 Israeli soldiers died in Lebanon.
On Wednesday, Israeli planes rocketed suspected Hizbollah guerrilla targets in Iqlim al-Toufah, a rugged ridge north of the Israeli-held zone. No one was hurt in the air attack.

Hizbollah leads a guerrilla war to oust some 1,000 Israeli troops and the 3,000-strong SLA holding the south Lebanon zone. The strip was set up by Israel in 1985 to protect its northern border area from guerrilla raids.
